searchText: It says it uses Verkle-IPA.. And that is definitely not in the 2030 roadmap. And there's no reason whatsoever to use it. So I'd take this post with humor. An expensive way to throw credits to the bin almost.. Vibehouse on the other side seems a more curated thing. You can take a look to it from <@688748669268132001> also https://github.com/jiayaoqijia/eth2030?tab=readme-ov-file#features > Full EVM execution -- 164+ opcodes, 24 precompiles, EOF container support, go-ethereum v1.17.0 backend > 100% EF conformance -- 36,126/36,126 Ethereum Foundation state tests passing via go-ethereum v1.17.0 backend > 58+ EIPs supported -- Covering Frontier through Prague and beyond (native + go-ethereum backend) it's geth + stuff of course it has full EVM execution and EF conformance, that part is literally geth https://github.com/jiayaoqijia/eth2030?tab=readme-ov-file#native-vs-delegated-architecture the zk stuff also isn't real because "production ZK backend integration pending" That would great. I am happy to contribute my existing CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.
